=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2687-2753 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new cycle-derivation block and its top-level call `validation_cycle_resolve || true` (line 2752) sit between `write_result_files()` and `emit_phase_failure_marker()`, inside the slice that tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:356 extracts, so the test harness dies before writing status.json.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail` with `VALIDATION_CYCLE` unset and `is_tracking_run` undefined, the call exits fatally, which gives the CI FileNotFoundError for status.json (check-run tests-hooks-and-orchestrator). Reviewers rated it BLOCKER; critical is the closest ledger severity.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2720 (with scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15151-15169) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The poller dispatches the validation workflow before posting the "Runtime validation dispatched ... Cycle: N" comment, so a fast-starting run can read the previous dispatch comment and derive cycle N-1.
  WHY: A cycle-3 run can resolve as cycle 2 and miss the cross-cycle escalation for that run. Severity disagreement: anthropic rated it NIT (confidence 3); the others rated it MAJOR. MAJOR is mapped to high.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2729 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The resolver paginates all tracking-issue comments, and this traversal is not shared with `validation_owner_load_bounced` or the `PRIOR_COMMENTS` fetch (~line 4560).
  WHY: This costs up to about 25 extra API calls per run on issues near the comment cap, which wastes the shared GitHub API budget. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2703 (and the other `cycle=${VALIDATION_CYCLE}` echoes at 2709, 2723, 2737, 2749, 2755) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `${VALIDATION_CYCLE}` is interpolated without a default, so the block is fatal under `set -u` when evaluated before the initialization at line 216.
  WHY: Any extractor that runs the block early hits an unbound-variable exit. A `${VALIDATION_CYCLE:-1}` guard would make placement safe.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:validation_cycle_resolve (after the `validation_owner_pipeline_login` call) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A successful login lookup returning an empty string is not rejected, so the jq filter `(.login // "") == $login` could match comments with an empty author login.
  WHY: This is reachable only if `validation_owner_pipeline_login` returns 0 with empty output, which was not confirmed. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash noted that the helper already fails closed at validate_process.sh:2281.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2752 (block at 2687-2753) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The top-level call `validation_cycle_resolve || true` falls inside the slice that tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:356 extracts as `write_result_files`.
  WHY: It reads unset `VALIDATION_CYCLE`, so status.json is never written, and `test_write_result_files_emits_failure_summary_only_for_non_pass` regresses. Fix: move the call or the block to after `emit_phase_failure_marker()`, still before the `PRIOR_COMMENTS=` fetch at ~4560.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2720; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15151-15169 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The poller dispatches before posting the dispatch comment, so a run can derive N-1.
  WHY: The window is small and the next run corrects itself. Fixing it needs a poller change that the issue excludes.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:validation_cycle_resolve (after `login="$(validation_owner_pipeline_login)"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: An empty login from a successful lookup is not rejected.
  WHY: This is reachable only if the helper returns 0 with empty output, which was not confirmed. A `[ -z "${login}" ]` guard returning `reason=login_unavailable` would close it.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:validation_cycle_resolve paginated comments call | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: An additional full traversal of the tracking-issue comments is added.
  WHY: It costs up to about 25 extra calls per run, and the three reads are not shared.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2752 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `validation_cycle_resolve || true` runs inside the code slice extracted by test_validate_process_template_mode.py.
  WHY: The harness lacks the tracking-issue environment, so the function fails and status.json is never written.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2724-2729 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The GitHub API is queried for tracking-issue comments on every call to `validation_cycle_resolve`.
  WHY: Repeated calls would waste the shared API budget.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:validation_cycle_resolve (after `validation_owner_pipeline_login`) (hardening suggestion)
  PROBLEM: An empty login string could lead to incorrect comment filtering.
  WHY: Suggested fix: `[ -z "${login}" ] && return 0`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2687-2753 (call at line 2752) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new resolver block is included in the source slice that tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:356 extracts as `write_result_files()`.
  WHY: Under `set -u` the resolver calls undefined `is_tracking_run` and expands unset `VALIDATION_CYCLE`, so the shell exits before status.json is created. The PR's CI log confirms this.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2720; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15151, 15157-15169 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The poller dispatches the workflow before posting the dispatch comment that the resolver reads.
  WHY: A cycle-3 run can resolve as cycle 2 and skip the cross-cycle escalation for that run.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2720 and 4560-4561 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The resolver paginates the full comment history, and cycle-2-or-later runs paginate the same endpoint again for `PRIOR_COMMENTS`.
  WHY: Each traversal can need 25 page requests on a 2,500-comment issue, and the new one runs even on cycle 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2687-2753 (call at line 2752) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cycle-derivation block sits between `write_result_files()` and `emit_phase_failure_marker()`, so the test's extraction at tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:356 includes it.
  WHY: It calls `is_tracking_run` and `validation_owner_pipeline_login`, which are undefined in the stub. The shell exits before status.json is created, which causes the CI failure. Fix: move the block to after `emit_phase_failure_marker()` (after line 2858).
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2720 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The poller (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh) dispatches before posting the dispatch comment, so a fast run can see the previous dispatch (N-1) as newest.
  WHY: The `cycle >= 3` escalation fires one cycle late. A fix would post the comment before dispatching, or have the resolver account for the in-flight dispatch.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2720 (also ~4560 and ~2311) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cycle-derivation read is not cached or reused with the `PRIOR_COMMENTS` and `validation_owner_load_bounced` reads.
  WHY: A third unshared traversal adds up to 25 API calls per run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2684-2757 (call at line 2752) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cycle block sits at the boundary of the slice that tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:356 extracts. In the harness `validation_cycle_resolve || true` runs with `VALIDATION_CYCLE` unset and `is_tracking_run` undefined, so the unbound variable (line 2703 echo) is fatal under `set -u`.
  WHY: status.json is never created, giving FileNotFoundError at tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:419 (run 40034624682, job 120690948227). Fix: move the block after `emit_phase_failure_marker()`. tests/test_validate_process_cross_cycle_escalation.py:325-330 (`test_cycle_derivation_runs_before_prior_comments_fetch`) pins the current placement and must be updated.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2720; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15151-15169 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The poller dispatches before posting the dispatch comment, so the resolver can derive N-1.
  WHY: The cross-cycle escalation fires one cycle late, or never if `MAX_VALIDATION_DISPATCHES_PER_CYCLE` runs out first. Posting the comment before dispatch removes the race.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2703 (and other `${VALIDATION_CYCLE}` echoes) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `${VALIDATION_CYCLE}` is interpolated without a default.
  WHY: Any early extractor gets a fatal unbound-variable exit. A `${VALIDATION_CYCLE:-1}` guard would make placement safe.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2719-2721 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The full paginated read of tracking comments is not reused by `validation_owner_load_bounced` (line 2285) or the `PRIOR_COMMENTS` fetch (line 4560).
  WHY: The run spends up to about 50-75 requests where one cached traversal would do, against the §14 API-hygiene guidance.
